duration.text: The Chinese Language at Liaoning Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2763 USD/per year ￥ 19900 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should be 18 years old or above 2.Be in good health condition 3.Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the social customs and habits6.Have good moral character and obey the laws and regulations of the . 4.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
